feeds.title: Urban Concepts Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1997, Urban Concepts was created to provide high-quality furniture at an affordable price. Offering a wide variety of products that are innovative, functional, and durable. We continuously aim to provide furniture for everyday life at its best; maintaining integrity, reliability, and trust as our forefront values in serving clients.

feeds.title: Manila Office Furniture Den Blog
feeds.description: Manila Office Furniture Den is a manufacturer of quality furniture in the Philippines. We customize different types of furniture for corporate and residential spaces. We work closely with our clients to ensure that the aesthetic and efficiency of our products fit their needs. Our products are well-crafted from planning, design, actual production, and quality control.

feeds.title: Rock Robins Design
feeds.description: Rock Robins is a sought after interior designer working on various residential and commercial projects in Metro Manila and other provinces. He graduated from the prestigious Ateneo de Manila University in 2002 with a degree in Business Management and took up an associate degree in interior design from the Philippine School of Interior Design.

feeds.title: Gal at Home Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Camyl Besinga and I have always loved seeing other people's spaces and how they make it work for their own unique lifestyles and preferences. My aim is to help people who don't know what to do with their own spaces. I want to help you see your home with fresh eyes. To help you embrace the uniqueness of your home situation. To give you ideas on how to assess your space, plan it correctly, and style it accordingly.

feeds.title: Grupo Santamaria Blog
feeds.description: Musings on design, travel, and art. Behind-the-scenes stories from our current projects. Insights on industry events and exhibits. Articles from published and online magazines and books. Grupo Santamaria has over 15 years of commitment to design that enhances life by improving the spaces it moves within.

feeds.title: Blims Fine Furniture Blog
feeds.description: BLIMS Furniture offers high-quality, modern, & functional furniture in the Philippines. Browse living room sets, dining room furniture, & accent chairs now!

feeds.title: CMV Interior Designs Blog
feeds.description: We are CMV Interior Designs, a Manila-based interior design firm that focuses on residential and commercial design. Founded in April 2014, our design approach exudes contemporary and chic interiors. Our interior design firm provides a design solution for our private and corporate clients with discerning tastes.

feeds.title: Polygon Blog
feeds.description: At Polygon, we believe that architecture is a vessel to cultivate relationships. We design work spaces to facilitate collaboration for teams, commercial spaces to enhance customer experience, or homes to foster a family's growth. Each project is an opportunity to create architecture that inspires and connects people.

feeds.title: Homify
feeds.description: Searching for inspiration for your property? At Homify, you'll find everything you need for conceptualizing and planning through to implementation!Homify is an architecture and design portal that connects users and professionals worldwide.
